title: Edit organization: hide Parent Organization and Sort Order on a single-organization deployment with a field-group requiresFeature
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czvZykUqhYxYXSSDt4

Filing gate: ③ a maintainer-directed task. Ruling recorded on #30210 in comment 6670372892 (`domain:server#2`): the maintainer answered 「同意」 to the presentation, which says "Row 4 A (separate `domain:server` card, presentation §2)". This card carries row 4 A of #30210. #30210 keeps row 4 C (the help text, PR #30686) and row 3 D, and closes without this card.

## Business reason

On a deployment that runs one organization, Edit organization shows 上级组织 / Parent Organization and 排序 / Sort Order. They do nothing there. Row 4 C (PR #30686) only adds a help line saying so. This card hides the two fields where they cannot matter, so a single-organization administrator never sees them. Without it, every single-organization customer keeps seeing two fields that read like they configure something.

## Ruled shape (verbatim from 6670372892)

> **Row 4 A (separate `domain:server` card, presentation §2):** a field-group-level `requiresFeature: 'multiOrgEnabled'`, lowered at resolve time to the group's `visibleWhen`; scope = the `packages/spec` field-group schema + `packages/lint` accepting the lowered gate + `sys_organization` declaring `fieldGroups`. The ui needs no change (`record-details.tsx` ~L232/L397 already bind field-group `visibleWhen` to features). The spec touch sets its review tier per the skill.

The precedent is the action-level `requiresFeature`, which is lowered into `visible` at parse time and stripped from the output (`packages/spec/src/ui/action.form.ts` L182 on `main` `66a8822b`).

## Reader who acts

`domain:server` claims it, per the ruling. The diff touches `packages/spec/**` (a new key on the field-group schema, a widening), so it is `Clause-②: yes`, `Metadata-protocol: added`, and owes the contract-review-tier review before the queue. `Skills-docs:` is owed in the PR.

## Re-check

- `grep -n "requiresFeature" packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`: no field-group key yet (0 hits on `main` `66a8822b`).
- `grep -n "fieldGroups" packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-organization.object.ts`: not declared yet (0 hits on `main` `66a8822b`).

Dedupe (issue search, open and closed): `requiresFeature field group` 15 hits, `multiOrgEnabled fieldGroups` 2, `field-group requiresFeature` 7, `sys_organization fieldGroups` 6. The only match is #30210 itself. **New.**
